author: Tempus
body:
I need a name for this beeeeeatiful map, with something relating to pokemon.
Anyone played pokemon red / yellow / blue / green?
The spawns and teams are Charmander, Squirtle, Bulbasaur, and Pikachu, or Fire, Water, Grass, and Electric.

You spawn in a head. :3

Images : http://imgur.com/a/B0Uwx
YML : Ø
Download : Ø
 
I'm honestly only about 30% - 40% done with this, so any help is wonderful!
 
 
I'm putting this on Hold because I dont' have any reason to continue, imma start some more for inspiration.

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I think the heads should be more pixel-art-ish and less organic, since more people will recognize them and it will be more of a tribute to the Pokemon art style.
But overall I love the concept :)

Maybe something like "Pokemon Stadium" or "Pokebrawl," idk. I'm terrible with names.
